Sơn Tùng M-TP (born on July 5th, 1994) is Vietnam’s leading pop superstar and one of Southeast Asia’s most influential contemporary artists.

With billions of streams and multiple digital records, Sơn Tùng M-TP has redefined the scale of success for modern Vietnamese pop. Since his breakthrough, he has consistently topped the charts, delivered music videos with hundreds of millions of views, and sold out major live performances - cementing his place at the forefront of V-Pop. 

Blending Pop, R&B, and Hip-hop with a bold visual identity, Sơn Tùng M-TP has shaped a new generation of youth culture in Vietnam. His branding, cinematic productions, and trend-setting aesthetics have elevated V-Pop beyond domestic boundaries.

Expanding internationally, he has released English-language music and collaborated with global artists such as Snoop Dogg. In May 2026, he further advanced this vision with Come My Way, an English-language single featuring Tyga. Built around Afrobeats with elements of Hip-hop and contemporary Pop, the release combines a global sound with cinematic imagery inspired by Vietnamese culture, reinforcing his ambition to bring Vietnamese music to a wider international audience.

More than a hitmaker, Sơn Tùng M-TP is a cultural phenomenon whose influence spans fashion, fandom culture, and generational identity. Often referred to as the "King of V-Pop," he is one of the defining figures of contemporary Asian pop music.
